## Summary

Implemented the command context and shared deploy helpers.

**`src/commands/context.ts`** (additive):
- `CommandContext` now has optional `runtime?: () => ContainerRuntime` and `clock?: Clock`, so the frozen `{ io, env }` shape still typechecks.
- Added `NO_RUNTIME_MESSAGE`, `defaultRuntimeFactory()` (throws `Error(NO_RUNTIME_MESSAGE)`), and `contextClock()`.
- `withStore` now opens the store with `{ clock: contextClock(context) }`.
- Added `withEngine` — resolves the runtime factory *before* `withStore`, then passes `{ store, runtime, clock }` (no `onProgress`).

**`src/commands/deploy-helpers.ts`** (new): `parseDuration`, `parseTail`, `formatUptime`, `shortContainerId` exactly per contract.

**`tests/commands-runtime.test.ts`** (new): covers every acceptance line.
